name: agent-eval-foundry
description: Measure how many independent things a benchmark suite actually measures, given the bank of subjects it was graded against.

scripts.report: node dist/cli.js report examples/durable-outbox/matrix.json --out reports/durable-outbox-axis-report.md && node dist/cli.js report --import swebench --null-trials 3 examples/public-swebench-verified/swebench-verified.raw.json --out reports/public-swebench-verified-axis-report.md && node dist/cli.js family run --out examples/families/prompt-injection-containment/matrix.json && node dist/cli.js family scenarios --out examples/families/prompt-injection-containment/scenarios.json && node dist/cli.js challenge build --out examples/families/prompt-injection-containment/challenge && node dist/cli.js family run --family prompt-injection-memory-poisoning --out examples/families/prompt-injection-memory-poisoning/matrix.json && node dist/cli.js family run --family ui-action-record-replay --out examples/families/ui-action-record-replay/matrix.json && node dist/cli.js challenge build --family prompt-injection-memory-poisoning --out examples/families/prompt-injection-memory-poisoning/challenge && node dist/cli.js challenge build --family ui-action-record-replay --out examples/families/ui-action-record-replay/challenge && node dist/cli.js family shape --family prompt-injection-memory-poisoning --out examples/shapes/prompt-injection-memory-poisoning.json && node dist/cli.js family shape --family ui-action-record-replay --out examples/shapes/ui-action-record-replay.json && node dist/cli.js all
